opening.argument: The video directs viewers into a BUSD investment program through a referral pathway and wallet-based registration, while the displayed program requires a 10 BUSD entrance fee and advertises fixed profit and protection against falling prices. The speaker directs viewers to join through a description link, group, or referral ID: “if you want to work under me then links are available in description.” The flow then shows wallet authorization, payment confirmation, password entry, registration, and account activation, including the instruction to “insert your password and click on register.” Yet the dashboard shows zero partners and zero BUSD results, and the wallet screen does not establish that any payment was completed. The available evidence likewise does not establish that the promised claims were accurate, that authorization succeeded, or that any loss occurred.
